question.text: Under Chapter V of SEBI (Intermediaries) Regulations 2008, actions against a defaulting PM include ALL EXCEPT:

explanation.text: The Logic: Client arrest is not a listed action. SEBI can suspend, cancel, prohibit, debar or warn. The Trap: Actions target the PM, not clients.
